preamble: Loss of nasality and fronting of the velar nasal [ŋ] to the palatal glide [j] before front vowels. In Cantonese the Middle Chinese 疑 (ŋ-) initial became j- before front vowels, while Hakka keeps ŋi- and Mandarin has a zero initial.

examples.note: Initial ŋ before a front vowel became j in Cantonese; Hakka keeps ŋi and Mandarin has zero initial (yí).
